rubric.note: Geometry is unchanged since db29fbd. The report.json diff at ac21f3b changes only hashes, host load and lightmap scale. The low mesh is still 8,757 tris and the high mesh 67,501, the GLB is still 756,540 bytes and the seven colliders are identical. The apse, the three pointed walnut-framed lancets, the stepped altar and the gear chandelier on the axis still read well in the hero shot. Still open: the ceiling is a flat plank deck with two beams and no vault or rib over the apse, so the 12 x 12 x 6 m volume reads as a box (hero y 0-180). The apse is a shallow stone-faced slab with a pointed opening (hero x 548-727), not a recessed bay. There is no dais under the guardian socket (D1).

Unchanged. The aisle inlays, the floor ring, the two brazier pillars and the chandelier still converge on the shrine, and the reward sits on a two-step altar with candles. The guardian position at z=-3 is still flat floor inside a thin ring inlay, measured at luma 49 against open floor at 41 in the hero shot. Nothing raises or encloses the fight. The altar collider tops out at y 1.36. Read cold, the room is a chapel with a shrine, not yet a boss arena.

Fixed: the centre-lancet wash. Hero-shot lancets read luma 69.7, 72.3 and 73.0 (left, centre, right), and at the reward eye 65.8, 72.8 and 68.2, previously 115 against 68. Improved: the wall gears are golden-brown, no longer rust. On brass-masked pixels the engine reads 107,64,25, luma 70, hue 29, G/R 0.60, previously G/R 0.39. That is still short of polished brass #DEC16A (hue 45, G/R 0.87), and the bake shows the same values (hue 33, G/R 0.59), so this is albedo under deep fire light (D6). Still open: the brazier flames are faceted pyramid shards (zoomed crops of the hero and reward-eye shots). Still open, a runtime problem: the metallic polished-brass parts go grey in the engine. The apse oculus gear reads 83,59,46 unmasked in the engine against 60,31,5 lightmap-only and 65,35,6 in Blender, so the blue channel rises from 5 to 46 and the hue is lost. The Blender brazier render shows that gear gold, while the engine brazier shot shows it silver-grey. The chandelier on a fixed mask (n=1029) reads 86,62,37 (luma 66) in the engine against 141,79,26 (luma 88) lightmap-only and 169,97,34 in Blender. Still open: the centre-lancet gilt mullion is a pale line at luma 111 against glass at 72 (reward eye). Lightmap density is still 42.6 px/m mean and 36.0 minimum, against 66.3 and 52.9 for the study (D2). The stone, damask and floor pattern stay crisp and in the kit's language.

Partly fixed: flame colour. On an L>100 mask the engine flames read R-B 115-134, hue 30 (hero 201,143,86, reward eye 213,149,87), previously 95. Lightmap-only and Blender read R-B 146-158, so the runtime still loses about 20-25% of the warmth, less than the near-parity c0dd517 reports (167.9 against 171, a different mask). Candle amber #F3BE65 is R-B 142. Kept: brazier pools. The floor at the brazier foot reads luma 61.8 against open floor at 40.5 (+53%), with a glow column up the pillar (53 against 36 at the pillar top), and stained-glass patches land on the floor. Still open: overall value. The hero frame mean is luma 33.7 against 56.1 for the study engine frame. Wallpaper reads 30-40 against the study's 52-78. engine-compare frame means are unchanged (hero 34.0 to 34.2). There is still no wall-mounted source, while the study has two sconces in frame. The polished brass also picks up a neutral-to-cool probe cast, and the art bible says no cool ambient fill.

rubric.criterion: readability and comfort at seated VR distance
rubric.note: The single strong axis, the open floor and the large scale keep the guardian and reward positions obvious and comfortable seated. Deductions: at the reward eye-point the flame shards sit at eye height on both frame edges as bright hard-edged wedges (luma 158-160). They are now amber instead of pale peach but still crystalline. The dark side walls (luma 30-40) flatten the room's width at a glance.

topFixes: Stop the engine greying metallic brass. In the full frame the oculus gear (83,59,46 against 60,31,5 lightmap-only) and the chandelier (86,62,37 against 141,79,26) lose their hue to the placeholder studio probe. Give the room a warm in-room probe (an amber-tinted environment or PMREM from the bake), or let the brass-polished slot keep its lightmap diffuse, so polished brass reads near #DEC16A as the art bible prescribes. While there, close the remaining flame gap (R-B 115-134 in engine against 146-158 in the bake).

Replace the faceted pyramid flames on the four braziers with soft flame cards or tapered tongues with a soft alpha edge. They are the brightest hard shapes at the reward eye-point (luma 158-160). Dull the centre-lancet gilt mullion (luma 111 against glass at 72) so it stops splitting the window.

Turn the shrine into an arena and lift the value. Raise a stepped dais under the guardian socket, which needs the src/content/rooms.ts socket change that D1 leaves to Paul. Add ribbed arches or a vault over the apse instead of the flat plank deck. Add baked wall sconces so the wallpaper rises from luma 30-40 toward the study's 52-78 and the frame mean rises from 33.7 toward 56, with the brazier pools still dominant.
independentScore.method: Judged the engine frames first. Viewed in full all six docs/verification/p5-rooms-guardian-vault-*.jpg, the review sheet and a montage of the study hero (Blender lightmapped and engine), the vault brazier (Blender lightmapped and engine), the engine seam-south PNG and the EEVEE high-poly hero. Pillow crops zoomed 2-3x of the wall gears, apse oculus, flames and altar. With numpy, measured sRGB region means, Rec.709 luma, HLS hue, R-B and G/R in the same pixel boxes across the engine full frame, the engine lightmap-only frame, the Blender lightmapped render and the Cycles diffuse reference. Masks were brass G/R>0.55 with L>35, flames L>100, and the chandelier on one fixed mask built from the lightmap-only frame. Same-box comparison put the flame warmth loss and the brass greying in the runtime (absent in the lightmap-only and Blender frames). Gear hue and overall darkness are in the bake too, so they come from source and lighting. The score weights the engine frames. Compared against the study engine frame p5-int-study.jpg (frame luma 56.1) and the study report (66.28 px/m mean). Read the art bible, report.json and its ac21f3b diff (geometry unchanged, density 42.63/35.99 px/m), engine-compare.json (frame ratio 0.917, RMSE 0.0377), uv1-report.json (coverage 0.373, 0 px overlap, min gap 15 px) and provenance.json (previous independentScore 73, decisions D1-D6). The previous review's side finding is fixed: all six stagingFiles and all seven reviewEvidence hashes in provenance.json now match the files on disk.

buildDecisions.by: orchestrator of the 2026-11-17 re-bake (build decisions, not owner approvals; Paul's review is still pending)

decisions.decision: Apse with a stepped altar behind the reward socket instead of a dais; greybox sockets unchanged (a dais needs src/content/rooms.ts to raise them, Paul's call).
Accept the vault's ~43 px/m lightmap mean (built 42.63) without zone weighting; one 2048 map cannot reach 65 px/m at uniform density.
The dielectric `gilt` CONST slot (a departure from the shared metallic PBR brass sets) is allowed for this build.
Keep the deeper fire colour: P5-T2 flames emit (1.0, 0.33, 0.06), unlike the hall and study candle flame.

notes: Coals and P5-T2 fire flames carry a dark albedo with strong emission (colour x 0.25, Blender strength and runtime emissiveIntensity x 4: coals 12.0 / 5.6, flame 24.0 / 5.6), so the emitted light is unchanged and the lightmap term on them is a quarter.
